note: Every layer alike, closeness before speed: resident rows on every rank (no resident caps), the RTX band on every rank (8 experts per call), the misses of ranks 0-3 that have a 2-bit record in CPU memory staged in every layer, the mean substitute for the rest. The staging time per call is bounded by K31_STAGE_CAP (records per decode call, largest routing weight first) and K31_STAGE_ROWS (staged ranks per row of a verify block), which the quality profile sets.
